scope: Two rounds of HLS and two bounded media-segment requests, MPEG-TS video/audio program evidence and live-playlist advancement; not a long-term guarantee or manual identity verification of every channel.

cctv_details.limits: Manual acceptance applies to the primary lines; backup lines were only checked using HLS and bounded media requests.

manual_acceptance_history.note: Earlier manual tests, not a claim that all newly added channels have been viewed.
